tickets.title: Validate and preserve real Cursor permission and plan requests
tickets.body:
## Context
E1 denies every inbound request. Captured permissions carry actual tool descriptions/options; plans carry toolCallId/name/overview/plan/todos/isProject/phases without sessionId or option list.

## What Needs to Change
Add version-grounded non-question adapters preserving raw supplied input/options/null absence. Validate complete option list before any choice; AD allow maps only allow_once, deny supported rejection/cancellation; captured plan accept/reject and separately validated cancellation. Bind verified launch/life/connection/session and type-distinct ACP ID independently of outbound prompt correlation; missing plan session is internal connection context, never added to raw payload.

## Key Files
- internal/cursorhost/protocol.go; session.go; transcript_linux.go; existing store permission/relay writes and API inspection projections as needed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Existing inspection exposes actual content/options with no invented details/origin; only once AD approval; malformed/duplicate/conflicting/unsupported schemas fail closed visibly; active ACP IDs cannot replace requests; simultaneous plan/permission independent; provenance captured versus source-derived/synthetic honest.

tickets.title: Enforce question denial before authorization admission
tickets.body:
## Context
Closed R3 denies questions under either setting. Archived direct/fallback handler shows question IDs, multiple allow_once and __ask_question_skip__; method-not-found can trigger fallback.

## What Needs to Change
One validated policy boundary before insert/relay/pane. Supported direct/multi/multiselect/fallback correlation; ambiguous authorization stays denied until proven non-question. Supported reject/cancel, bounded unsupported requests, no advertised support. Fresh/load policy shared but actual load E4. Question output is separate from admitted relay acknowledgement.

## Key Files
- internal/cursorhost/protocol.go; session.go; transcript_linux.go; initialization capabilities.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Questions never answerable requests/pane choices; both settings/relay modes/enabling-policy/allow attempts/persistent choices denied; malformed ambiguous never ordinary admission; no method-not-found-only defense/hang; concurrent genuine holds retained; no invented live question evidence.

tickets.title: Connect decisions to a bounded durably acknowledged request relay
tickets.body:
## Context
Reuse atomic InsertRelayRequest, DecideRelayRequest, AckRelayDecision and DenyRelayTimeout plus relayJudge absent-process finite settlement. Generic hook early-failure output cannot be forwarded unacknowledged.

## What Needs to Change
Recommended gateway-local bounded per-request controller with NULL hook process evidence, shared authenticated conditional admission and existing first-writer/ack store contracts. Preserve immediate-parent hook checks and equivalent transaction-time launch/life/runtime/connection/session guards. Task1 eligibility passed conservatively. Winning durable ack before enqueue of every relay response including deny; failed insert/ack zero replies, cancellation/fallback separate. Existing bounded writer retains request identity and blocks queued allow after cancellation/expiry/ownership change; uncertain writes never replay.

## Key Files
- internal/cursorhost/session.go; protocol.go; ownership.go; report.go; internal/store/relay_writes.go; cursor_runtime.go; existing conditional gate owners; hook timing helpers if reused; pkg/api/decide.go; relay_delivery.go.

## Acceptance Criteria
- First response byte impossible before own committed delivered_at; absent ack zero relay reply even deny; delivered means ack not receipt/execution/dialog; hook evidence NULL never gateway PID, finite confirm_by never extended; no ack/send after hard settlement; API/pane/timeout races at most one intended answer; store-lock deadlines checked at mutation, stale identity rejected, caller restart bounded; Claude/Codex unchanged.

Relay settlement retires the relay controller and all its queued responses, including allow and deny; it does not resolve a genuinely open connected native request. A deliberate fallen-back pane answer may use the same request arbiter, but terminal timeout/cancellation cannot revive a request and uncertain relay approval is never replayed as a pane answer. Failed/missing acknowledgement means zero relay ACP replies, including timeout denial: use separately validated cancellation or truthful bounded failure/fallback, never disguise a denial as cancellation. Preserve conservative holds until valid proof or owning-spawn end.

tickets.body:
## Context
Task1 owns eligibility/held reporting. Captured child-shell used main session ID, so session alone cannot prove main origin; tool status/child completion not necessarily execution.

## What Needs to Change
Correlate actual admitted requests and validated updates through existing proof/close machinery under launch/session/connection/tool ID. Only protocol evidence that actually establishes matching tool ran supplies execution proof; rejection/generic completion/plan acceptance do not. Preserve unknown false/NULL child, guarded cancellation/completion/shutdown holds, no child session substitution.

## Key Files
- cursorhost/session.go; report.go; hook/classify.go; handler.go; existing request proof reporting owner; store/request_proof.go; request_close.go; pane_writes.go; hook_writes.go.

tickets.title: Test durable acknowledgement before first relay response byte
tickets.body:
## Context
Shared request factory and store-lock/transport fault seams. Asynchronous protocol output requires observing the first response byte.

## What Needs to Change
Exercise actual relay output with an independent committed DB read at the first byte for allow, reject and timeout denial. Include missing/failed/deleted acknowledgement, store delays/failures, crash cuts and partial output.

## Key Files
- cursorhost relayboundary/protocol tests; cursorfix; pkg/api/apitest/writelock.go.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every relay response begins after its own durable delivered_at; failed/missing ack emits zero relay reply bytes, including denial. Cancellation is distinct. Decision is not acknowledgement, and acknowledged-but-unreceived or partial output never permits replay or execution claims.

Explicit final-write cases: queued allow AND deny crossing expiry/cancellation/ownership loss, and delayed store locks crossing confirm_by. Neither late ack nor retired response occurs; independent genuine holds remain and terminal requests never revive.

## Complete-file review execution

As for Task1, the architecture is about 1.5 MB. The initial DocWriter must report exact personally reviewed sections and may leave this subtask active until whole-file review completes. After canonical edits settle, root dispatches cold read-only reviewers over contiguous, nonoverlapping ranges covering every line of the same current architecture snapshot, plus complete smaller touched docs. Their reports and hash/range coverage satisfy the aggregate reread requirement. Automated scans supplement this evidence and never substitute for model reading. Correct mandatory current factual findings in one batched DocWriter rework pass, reviewing its exact delta; preserve documented deferrals of broad inherited normalization. Root closes review only when coverage and mandatory corrections are complete. This is a technical execution division, not a user approval gate.
